name: com.soniseli.wfc
description: Designer-friendly procedural map generation using the Wave Function Collapse algorithm (tiled model). Deterministic, seeded solver with live visualization and editor tooling.

samples.description: Six tile sets made from CC0 pixel art (meadow, lakes, forests, mountains, castles and all of them together), and a scene with a generator to try them in Play mode or the WFC Studio window.
The interactive web demo: pick a tile set, size and seed, then watch, pause or step the generation. Needs the Puny World Tile Sets sample, the Input System and URP.
